notes: Modified cash basis audit, FYE 9/30/2022. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5); business-type from the proprietary (Enterprise Fund) statement p7, measure 'cash' (modified cash basis; net position equals cash), as in FY2023. Fund balances recorded as fund balances (beginning 1,018,058 / ending 1,309,491, p5); beginning cash not printed (null); ending cash = cash and cash equivalents 990,131 (p3), certificates of deposit 311,439 as ending_investments, county treasurer cash 7,921 printed separately. Statement 'Intergovernmental' 228,994 split using the General Fund schedule's printed breakdown (p9) of its 101,454 (adds exactly); Debt Service 12,894 + Road 114,646 keep the parent label. 'Other receipts' 17,225 not split (schedule pieces add to 17,226). Bond anticipation note proceeds are printed among revenues (governmental 260,000, p4; enterprise 390,000 in nonoperating revenues, p7), so recorded as Bond Proceeds receipt lines. Transfers: Total column shows transfers in blank and transfers out 11,869 after the Reclassifications column nets 91,000; Enterprise transfers in 11,869. Printed governmental Total revenues/expenditures each exceed the Total column's lines by 23,562 (reclassification column left out of the printed totals); recorded as printed with report_discrepancies; the fund-balance roll-forward ties using the lines. Business-type receipts total = operating 214,967 + nonoperating revenues 390,977 (no single printed total); disbursements = Statement of Activities business-type expenditures 250,380 (p1). 'Community Development' (CDA, TIF-funded) recorded as economic development (no betterment wording printed). Intergovernmental in Debt Service and Special Revenue schedules = other state aid (no allocation type printed). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets and fund balances (p3; totals equal government-wide), business-type from p6; totals from p2. Detail: per-fund budget schedules (General Fund types pp9-12, Debt Service p13, Special Revenue types p14 combining Road and CDA, Water p15, Sewer p16); the all-funds budget schedule (p8) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Capital outlay lines with a blank actual (General government, Cemetery, Park, Hall and Office; Water professional fees; Water transfers in) are not recorded. Read pages 1-16 of 16
